nodes.description: Owner state variable (address payable), privileged account stored in the proxy storage layout.
Pending owner state variable used by the two-step ownership transfer flow.
Mapping(address => uint256) of admin authorization levels checked by the onlyAdmin modifier.
Implementation/logic contract address used as the delegatecall target by the proxy fallback.
External caller address; determines ownership/admin authorization and receives initial constructor privileges.
onlyOwner function that sets pendingOwner to the requested next owner.
Function that lets the pendingOwner claim ownership and become owner.
onlyOwner function that directly overwrites the owner state variable.
onlyOwner function that writes an authorization level for a given admin address.
onlyOwner external function that updates the proxy implementation address.
Internal helper that performs the raw write of _implement.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls into the stored implementation with raw calldata.
Payable receive function accepting plain ether transfers.
DELEGATECALL executed in the fallback; arbitrary external code runs with the proxy's storage and context.
Owner constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender and admins[msg.sender] = 1.
Address parameter of transferOwnership destined for pendingOwner.
Address parameter of setOwner destined for the owner state variable.
Address parameter of setAdmin used as the mapping key.
uint256 parameter of setAdmin giving the authorization level stored in admins.
Address parameter of setProxyLogic passed through to _setProxyLogic.
Local payable copy of msg.sender in acceptOwnership, required to equal pendingOwner.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before allowing the ownership transfer request.
onlyOwner modifier gates the direct owner overwrite with the untrusted caller address.
onlyOwner modifier gates the admin authorization write with the untrusted caller address.
onlyOwner modifier gates the proxy logic update with the untrusted caller address.
acceptOwnership requires the untrusted caller to equal pendingOwner before granting ownership.
The _nextOwner argument is written into pendingOwner inside transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner state that later authorizes a privileged ownership claim.
The _nextOwner argument is written into the owner state variable inside setOwner.
setOwner directly overwrites the owner state variable, the root of all authorization.
The _admin argument is used as the key of the admins mapping write.
The auth argument defines the authorization level stored for the admin.
setAdmin mutates the admins mapping that the onlyAdmin privilege check relies on.
The local sender variable is derived from msg.sender and compared against pendingOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes the verified caller to owner, changing the privilege root.
The logicAddr argument flows through to the internal implementation writer.
setProxyLogic invokes the internal _setProxyLogic helper.
_setProxyLogic stores logicAddr into the _implement state variable.
The stored _implement address is consumed as the delegatecall target in the fallback.
The fallback executes an assembly DELEGATECALL, forwarding all calldata to arbitrary external code.
The delegatecall target can call back into the proxy fallback, re-entering privileged logic with the proxy's storage.
The constructor grants owner and admin level 1 to the untrusted deployer msg.sender.
The constructor seeds admins[msg.sender] = 1, establishing the initial privileged account.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the initial authorization root.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only carries the value written to pendingOwner inside transferOwnership, so it is absorbed by that function node.
The parameter is used only to overwrite the owner state variable inside setOwner and has no independent security meaning.
The parameter is just the mapping key consumed by setAdmin and is subsumed by the function node.
The auth value is written directly into the admins mapping by setAdmin, so it folds into that function node.
The parameter only flows from setProxyLogic into the implementation storage write, collapsing into the function node.
The local variable is a temporary copy of msg.sender checked inside acceptOwnership and adds no separate core node.
